entries.toelichting: Two cities (Josh 10:3,5,23; 12:11; 15:35; 21:29; Neh 11:29). English convention: Jarmuth.

Major prophet and others (~146 occ in Jer plus 2Kgs 23:31; 24:18; 1Chr 5:24; 12:4,10,13; 2Chr 35:25; 36:12,21,22; Ezr 1:1; Neh 10:2; 12:1,12,34; Dan 9:2). English convention: Jeremiah. 'YHWH-establishes'.
Plant-blight, also human pallor (Deut 28:22; 1Kgs 8:37; 2Chr 6:28; Jer 30:6; Amos 4:9; Hag 2:17). Hyphenated.

Qal/Ni/Pi/Hi/Hophal: sit, dwell, abide, remain (~1090 occurrences spanning all OT — covering literal sitting, residing-in-place, dwelling, enthronement, settling). Standard concordant 'sit-dwell' preserves both physical-sitting and habitation kernels.
David's mighty man (2Sam 23:8). Hyphenated. English convention: Josheb-basshebeth.
Philistine giant (2Sam 21:16). Hyphenated. English convention: Ishbi-benob.
Gentilic of Jashub (Num 26:24). English convention: Jashubite.
Place or family (1Chr 4:22). Hyphenated. English convention: Jashubi-lehem.
David's chief of three (1Chr 11:11; 12:6; 27:2). English convention: Jashobeam.
Son of Abraham by Keturah (Gen 25:2; 1Chr 1:32). English convention: Ishbak.
Issacharite and post-exilic returnee (Num 26:24; 1Chr 7:1; Ezr 10:29). English convention: Jashub.
Asherite and son of Saul (Gen 46:17; Num 26:44; 1Sam 14:49; 1Chr 7:30). English convention: Ishvi.

Joshua-variant, post-exilic high priest and others (1Chr 24:11; 2Chr 31:15; Ezr 2:2,6,36,40; 3:2,8,9; 4:3; 5:2; 8:33; 10:18; Neh 3:19; 7:7,11,39,43; 8:7,17; 9:4,5; 10:9; 11:26; 12:1,7,8,10,24,26). English convention: Jeshua. 'YHWH-saves' (root of NT-Greek Iesous/Jesus).
Variant spelling of Isaac (Ps 105:9; Jer 33:26; Amos 7:9,16). Hyphenated.
Multiple Levites (1Chr 7:3; 12:6; 23:20; 24:21,25; Ezr 10:31). English convention: Isshiah. 'YHWH-lends'.
Wilderness, waste-place (Num 21:20; 23:28; Deut 32:10; 1Sam 23:19,24; 26:1,3; Ps 68:7; 78:40; 106:14; Isa 43:19,20). Standard concordant.

Son of Abraham by Hagar, plus other persons (Gen 16:11,15,16; 17:18,20,23,25,26; 25:9,12,13,16,17; 28:9; 36:3; 1Chr 1:28,29,31; 8:38; 9:44; 2Chr 19:11; 23:1; Ezr 10:22; Jer 40:8-16; 41:1-18). English convention: Ishmael. 'Mighty-One-hears'.
Descendants of Ishmael (Gen 37:25,27,28; 39:1; Judg 8:24; 1Chr 2:17; 27:30; Ps 83:6). English convention: Ishmaelites.
David's mighty man and Zebulun chief (1Chr 12:4; 27:19). English convention: Ishmaiah. 'YHWH-hears'.
Judg 4:21; 1Sam 26:7; 1Kgs 18:27; Job 3:13; Ps 78:65; Song 7:9. Standard concordant.
David's mighty man (2Sam 23:32). English convention: Jashen.

Ni/Hi: deliver, save, give-victory (~205 occurrences spanning all OT — the deliverance-verb of Exodus, Judges, Psalms, Prophets — root of Yeshua/Joshua, of yeshuah salvation, of Yesha'yahu/Isaiah). Standard concordant.
Multiple Judahites and others (1Chr 2:31; 4:20,42; 5:24). English convention: Ishi.

Qal/Pi/Pu/Hi: be-straight, please-favorably, smooth-the-way (Num 23:27; 1Sam 6:12; 18:20,26; 2Sam 17:4; 1Kgs 9:12; 1Chr 13:4; 2Chr 30:4; Job 33:27; Ps 5:8; Prov 3:6; 4:25; 9:15; 11:5; 15:21; 29:27; Ecc 7:13; 11:9; 12:9; Isa 40:3; 45:2,13; Jer 31:9; Ezk 1:7,23). Hyphenated.

Patriarch's covenantal-name and the people, kingdom, and land — by far the most-frequent proper noun in the Hebrew Bible (~2506 occurrences across all OT books). Given to Jacob at Peniel (Gen 32:28) — 'one-who-strives-with-Mighty-One'. English convention: Israel.
Member of Israel (Lev 24:10,11; 2Sam 17:25). English convention: Israelite.
Poetic-name for Israel (Deut 32:15; 33:5,26; Isa 44:2). English convention: Jeshurun. 'Upright-one'.
Moabite, David's mighty man (1Chr 11:46). English convention: Ithmah.
Multiple persons (Ex 4:18; Judg 8:20; 1Kgs 2:5,32; 1Chr 2:17,32; 4:17; 7:38). English convention: Jether.
Father of Amasa (2Sam 17:25). English convention: Ithra.
Gentilic, David's mighty men (2Sam 23:38; 1Chr 2:53; 11:40). English convention: Ithrite.
Son of David (2Sam 3:5; 1Chr 3:3). English convention: Ithream.
Qal/Hi: suffer-pain (Gen 34:25; 2Kgs 14:10; Job 5:18; 14:22; Ps 69:29; Prov 14:13; Ezk 13:22; 28:24). Hyphenated.
Heaviness, mass, abundance (Num 20:20; Isa 21:15; 22:24; 30:27; Nah 3:3; Prov 27:3). Hyphenated.
Organ for sacrifice and divination (Ex 29:13,22; Lev 3:4,10,15; 4:9; 7:4; 8:16,25; 9:10,19; Prov 7:23; Lam 2:11; Eze 21:21). Standard concordant.

Pi/Pu/Hothpalpel: wash-by-treading garments (Gen 49:11; Ex 19:10,14; Lev 6:27; 11:25,28,32,40; 13:6,34,54,55,58; 14:8,9,47; 15:5-30; 16:26,28; 17:15,16; Num 8:7,21; 19:7,8,10,19,21; 31:24; 2Sam 19:24; Ps 51:2,7; Jer 2:22; 4:14; Mal 3:2). Hyphenated to mark fulling-action distinct from H7364 rachats wash.
Qal/Ni/Pi/Hi: bring-into-bondage (Gen 1:28; Num 32:22,29; Josh 18:1; 2Sam 8:11; 1Chr 22:18; 2Chr 28:10; Neh 5:5; Esth 7:8; Jer 34:11,16; Mic 7:19; Zech 9:15). Standard concordant.
Demonstrative-adverb 'thus, so' (extensively used in prophetic 'thus says YHWH', ~580 occ). Standard concordant.
Qal/Pi: be-faint, grow-dim (Gen 27:1; Deut 34:7; 1Sam 3:2,13; Job 17:7; Eze 21:7; Zech 11:17). Hyphenated.
Office-of-priest (Ex 29:9; 40:15; Num 3:10; 16:10; 18:1,7; 25:13; Josh 18:7; 1Sam 2:36; Ezr 2:62; Neh 7:64; 13:29). Standard concordant.
Refining-furnace (Deut 4:20; 1Kgs 8:51; Prov 17:3; 27:21; Isa 48:10; Jer 11:4; Eze 22:18,20,22). Hyphenated.
Place in Judah (1Sam 30:30). Hyphenated. English convention: Bor-ashan.
Mesopotamian oppressor (Judg 3:8,10). Hyphenated. English convention: Cushan-rishathaim.
Qal/Ni/Pi/Hi: be-false, deceive (Ps 78:36; 89:35; 116:11; Prov 14:5; 19:22; 23:3; 30:6; Isa 57:11; 58:11; Jer 15:18; Eze 13:19; Hos 4:2; Mic 2:11; Hab 2:3). Standard concordant.
Place where Shelah was born (Gen 38:5). English convention: Chezib.
Causal-and-evidential conjunction (~4475 occurrences across all OT — the most-frequent subordinator in Hebrew). Hyphenated.
Asseverative use; Job 5:7 'verily man is born'. Hyphenated.
Whole, every, totality (~5415 occurrences across all OT — the most-frequent quantifier in Hebrew). Standard concordant 'all' covers totalizing-and-distributive uses.
Son of David (2Sam 3:3). English convention: Chileab.
Place where Hezron died (1Chr 2:24). Hyphenated. English convention: Caleb-ephratah.
Variant of Caleb (1Chr 2:9). English convention: Chelubai.
Assyrian city of Nimrod (Gen 10:11,12). English convention: Calah.
Father of Shallum (Neh 3:15; 11:5). Hyphenated. English convention: Col-hozeh.
Container, weapon, instrument, equipment (~325 occurrences spanning all OT — covers vessels, weapons, instruments, household-implements, ornaments). Hyphenated to mark broad-instrumental kernel.
Son of Naomi (Ruth 1:2,5; 4:9). English convention: Chilion.
Wise-man and Judahite (1Kgs 4:31; 1Chr 2:6). English convention: Calcol.
Mesopotamian city (Gen 10:10; Amos 6:2). English convention: Calneh.
